Name: Exelon Corporation
Description: Exelon Corporation (Ticker: EXC) is a leading American energy provider and one of the largest utilities in the U.S., headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. As a Fortune 100 company incorporated in Pennsylvania, Exelon operates a diverse portfolio of generation assets, including nuclear, solar, and wind facilities, while delivering reliable electricity to millions of customers across several states. The company is committed to advancing clean energy solutions and enhancing grid resilience, positioning itself as a key player in the transition towards a sustainable energy future. With a strong focus on innovation and regulatory compliance, Exelon is strategically positioned to navigate the evolving energy landscape while delivering long-term value to its stakeholders.
